categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The quotes load request is read at data.quotes.data, which matches the documented response shape and has no unnecessary controls.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The keyless request uses the verified CoinMarketCap endpoint, exact IDs, USD conversion, and a load trigger; no unsupported route or auth requirement is introduced.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The template uses documented data and status roots, RefreshButton, and ordinary numeric formatting, though repeated toFixed and hand-built magnitude expressions are less consistent than the documented locale formatter.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: Price, 24-hour change, market cap, volume, and refresh context are rendered for the three requested assets, with a global source timestamp.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: The title and quote values have a basic hierarchy, but the ungrouped price strings, plain repeated rows, and lack of row division make the presentation ordinary.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: The asset name can truncate and the short Cap/24h vol labels save width, but the quote and two-stat rows are all forced to nowrap with no narrow-layout alternative.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: Loading, request error, empty result, and populated data each have explicit render branches.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: The labeled refresh and core figures are convenient, but ungrouped prices, fixed single-line detail groups, and zero fallbacks for absent metrics weaken quick repeated scanning.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: One load request keeps the data model lean, while duplicated trillion/billion formatting expressions and repeated metric markup add avoidable template complexity.
categoryReasons.accessibility: The market labels and percentage values are visible text and the refresh control has a text label, though missing percentage data can be presented as a colored zero.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: The only operation is a read-only quote request; no mutation or unsafe action is available.

strengths: The endpoint and asset ID filtering match the verified API contract.
The widget includes all requested market values and a refresh control.
Explicit loading, error, and empty states are present.
problems: Absent percentage, market-cap, or volume values fall back to numeric zero rather than an unavailable marker.
The nowrap detail groups have no alternate narrow-tile layout.
highestImpactFixes: Use locale-based USD formatting and preserve missing values as unavailable instead of displaying zero.
Make the market-cap and volume row adapt for narrow tiles instead of forcing both groups onto one line.
Replace the repeated magnitude conditionals with the installed compact number formatter.
